records.abstract_cn: COVID-19及相关限制措施是否被威权政府用来加强其权力控制？利用来自83个俄罗斯地区的数据，我们表明，确实如此——在疫情期间，正是制度质量和公民社会的力量限制了政府的信息操纵和压制，这两种威权政权的主要工具。在反对派领袖阿列克谢·纳瓦尔尼于2020年八月中毒及2021年一月入狱后发生的逮捕浪潮，在那些操纵COVID-19统计数据的地区更为明显。威权工具使用的增加付出了代价：错误信息降低了人们对疫情限制措施的遵守程度。除了双向固定效应外，我们还使用敏感性分析来考虑可能的遗漏变量。我们的发现与宣传和压制之间的理论互补性一致。在疫情严重程度和制度特征给定的条件下，政治压制更多的地区也表现出更大的信息操纵。

records.title_en: Green spills: Peer effects in pro-environmental behaviors
records.title_cn: 绿色溢出：亲环境行为中的同伴效应
records.abstract_en: This paper examines causal peer effects in pro-environmental behavior using geocoded panel data on 260,000 Swiss households from 2008 to 2019 and instrumental variables methods. We find that peer behavior has a simultaneous impact on a broad range of energy-related practices. In particular, we find that peer solar photovoltaic (PV) adoption increases household electricity conservation efforts, with each additional solar PV installation at 100 meters’ distance to a household reducing a household’s annual electricity consumption by 0.2%. We also document peer effects both within and across markets for pro-environmental durable goods, with increased uptake of solar PV and electric vehicles following new solar PV installations nearby. We find suggestive evidence that peer influence manifests itself in different ways contingent upon households’ constraints. Our findings have important implications for renewable energy subsidy evaluation. To illustrate this we calculate the marginal value of public funds (MVPF) of the existing solar PV subsidy scheme. In this setting, accounting for peer effects increases the estimated MVPF by approximately 17%.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用2008年至2019年间260,000户瑞士家庭的地理编码面板数据和工具变量方法，考察了亲环境行为中的因果同伴效应。我们发现，同伴行为对一系列广泛的能源相关实践具有同步影响。具体而言，我们发现同伴太阳能光伏（PV）的采用增加了家庭节电努力，每增加一个距离家庭100米的太阳能光伏安装，会使家庭年用电量减少0.2%。我们还记录了亲环境耐用品市场内部及跨市场的同伴效应，即附近新增太阳能光伏安装后，太阳能光伏和电动汽车的采用率随之提高。我们发现了提示性证据，表明同伴影响根据家庭约束条件的不同而以不同方式显现。我们的发现对可再生能源补贴评估具有重要意义。为说明这一点，我们计算了现有太阳能光伏补贴方案的公共资金边际价值（MVPF）。在此背景下，考虑同伴效应会使估计的MVPF增加约17%。

records.title_en: The impact of election fraud on government performance
records.title_cn: 选举欺诈对政府绩效的影响
records.abstract_en: I examine how election fraud affects the type of government corruption and red tape that inhibit economic growth, as measured by building permit approvals in the Philippines, which are often delayed due to requests for bribes. To identify effects, I exploit a switch to automated elections in 2010 that made committing fraud more difficult. Estimates from a research design comparing changes over time in previously high-fraud and low-fraud towns indicate that automated elections significantly reduced election fraud, and that this led to a sharp and sustained 15 percent increase in the number of building permits approved annually. Local budget outcomes and priorities do not appear to be affected.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了选举欺诈如何影响抑制经济增长的政府腐败和官僚程序类型，以菲律宾的建筑许可审批为衡量标准，这些审批常因索贿而延迟。为识别效应，我利用了2010年转向自动化选举这一变化，这使得实施欺诈更加困难。通过比较先前高欺诈和低欺诈城镇随时间变化的研究设计估计表明，自动化选举显著减少了选举欺诈，并导致每年批准的建筑许可数量急剧且持续地增加了15%。地方预算结果和优先事项似乎未受影响。

records.title_en: Wage spillovers across sectors: Evidence from a localized public-sector wage cut
records.title_cn: 跨部门工资溢出效应：来自地方性公共部门工资削减的证据
records.abstract_en: We study how institutional wage reforms in one sector spill over to other sectors by focusing on the public sector. We leverage the Japanese policy reform that cut public-sector wages only in certain municipalities and the institutional setting in which only young workers are eligible for public-sector jobs. We find that a 1% public-sector wage cut reduces the private-sector wages of young workers by 0.3%. This spillover elasticity is greater when public-sector jobs are more important as workers’ outside options. We also find evidence that private-sector firms’ employment and profits expand in response to the public-sector wage cut.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过聚焦公共部门，研究一个部门的制度性工资改革如何溢出到其他部门。我们利用日本的政策改革，该改革仅在特定市町村削减公共部门工资，以及只有年轻工人有资格获得公共部门工作的制度设置。我们发现，公共部门工资削减1%会使年轻工人的私营部门工资降低0.3%。当公共部门工作作为工人的外部选择更为重要时，这种溢出弹性更大。我们还发现证据表明，私营企业就业和利润因公共部门工资削减而扩张。

records.title_en: Basic income versus fairness: redistribution with inactive agents
records.title_cn: 基本收入与公平：存在非活跃个体的再分配
records.abstract_en: I study redistribution between inactive, unemployed, and employed agents who are heterogeneous in their preferences and their productive skills in the labor market and at home. The government considers that redistribution across skills is desirable, but redistribution across preferences is not: if everyone has the same preferences, equality is optimal, but if everyone has the same skills, laissez-faire is optimal. In turn, this leads to a simple sufficient statistic to assess any reform: any extra dollar of transfer should go to the agent whose consumption is the furthest below what she would have consumed if everyone had average skills. In high-income countries, the gap between the lowest consumption and the average production is empirically much larger in the labor market than among inactives. Hence, introducing an inactivity benefit, or basic income, would neither be welfare-improving nor optimal for that social welfare function, regardless of labor supply elasticities.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了在劳动力市场和家庭中偏好和生产技能异质的非活跃、失业和就业个体之间的再分配问题。政府认为跨技能的再分配是可取的，但跨偏好的再分配则不然：如果所有人偏好相同，平等是最优的；但如果所有人技能相同，自由放任是最优的。这进而引出一个简单的充分统计量来评估任何改革：每额外一美元的转移应给予其消费水平低于在平均技能假设下其本应消费水平最多的个体。在高收入国家，最低消费与平均生产之间的差距在劳动力市场中实证上远大于非活跃群体。因此，引入非活跃福利或基本收入，对于该社会福利函数而言，既不会改善福利，也不是最优的，无论劳动供给弹性如何。

records.title_en: Minimum wage laws and job search
records.title_cn: 最低工资法与求职
records.abstract_en: Simple theoretical models of job search can imply that a higher minimum wage increases the number of job seekers for affected jobs. Researchers often appeal to these models in defending or explaining non-negative estimated employment effects of minimum wages. We use novel data on job search in U.S. states to examine the effect of minimum wage increases on the number of job seekers for low-skilled positions. We find little if any evidence that higher minimum wages increase job search for low-skilled jobs, and more evidence that higher minimum wages decrease the number of workers seeking employment in these jobs.
records.abstract_cn: 简单的求职理论模型可以暗示，较高的最低工资会增加受影响工作的求职者数量。研究人员在辩护或解释最低工资对就业的非负估计效应时，常常引用这些模型。我们利用美国各州关于求职的新数据，考察最低工资上调对低技能职位求职者数量的影响。我们发现，几乎没有证据表明较高的最低工资会增加低技能工作的求职，反而有更多证据表明较高的最低工资会减少寻求这些工作就业的工人数量。

records.title_en: Fairness perceptions of redistribution and predistribution
records.title_cn: 再分配与前分配公平感知
records.abstract_en: To address rising income inequality, governments typically rely on two levers: predistribution policies that implement inequality reduction before incomes are earned—e.g., minimum-wage laws—and redistribution policies that implement inequality reduction after incomes are earned—e.g., taxes and transfers. We explore whether support for reducing inequality depends on the choice of policy lever. Using incentivized experiments with the general population of the US and Sweden (N=2510), we study inequality reduction under predistribution and redistribution, focusing on whether inequality reduction is implemented before or after income is earned. We find that timing matters: subjects in both countries reduce inequality more under predistribution than redistribution. Furthermore, subjects in the predistribution treatment more often invoke equal effort to justify reducing inequality, while those in the redistribution treatment more often invoke adherence to the initial agreement to justify preserving it. Overall, our results imply that the choice between predistribution and redistribution can influence public support for reducing inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 为应对日益加剧的收入不平等，政府通常依赖两种手段：前分配政策，即在收入赚取之前实施不平等削减，例如最低工资法；以及再分配政策，即在收入赚取之后实施不平等削减，例如税收和转移支付。我们探讨对减少不平等的支持是否取决于政策手段的选择。利用美国和瑞典普通人群的激励实验（N=2510），我们研究了前分配和再分配下的不平等削减，重点关注不平等削减是在收入赚取之前还是之后实施。我们发现时机很重要：两国受试者在前分配下比在再分配下更大幅度地减少不平等。此外，前分配处理中的受试者更常援引平等努力来证明减少不平等的合理性，而再分配处理中的受试者更常援引遵守初始协议来证明维持不平等的合理性。总体而言，我们的结果表明，前分配与再分配之间的选择可能影响公众对减少不平等的支持。

records.title_en: Non-monetary incentives and bureaucratic performance: Evidence from U.S. courts
records.title_cn: 非货币激励与官僚绩效：来自美国法院的证据
records.abstract_en: Federal judges—who enjoy lifetime tenure and constitutionally protected salaries—represent an especially hard test case for incentive-based bureaucratic reform. I study the “six-month list,” a reform requiring U.S. federal courts to publicly identify judges with overdue matters. Using a regression discontinuity design and other methods, I find that matters most exposed are resolved approximately 14% faster than those least exposed, with larger effects among younger, non-white, and female judges. The speed gains come with trade-offs: upfront time savings are partially offset by downstream delays, and more-exposed matters are more likely to be reversed on appeal. A bunching analysis estimates aggregate time savings of approximately 4%, demonstrating that non-monetary levers can shift behavior even among highly insulated elite professionals.
records.abstract_cn: 联邦法官——享有终身任期和宪法保障的薪水——代表了基于激励的官僚改革的一个特别严格的测试案例。我研究了“六个月清单”，这是一项要求美国联邦法院公开识别有逾期事项法官的改革。使用断点回归设计和其他方法，我发现最受关注的事项比最不受关注的事项解决速度快约14%，在年轻、非白人和女性法官中效果更大。速度提升伴随着权衡：前期时间节省部分被后续延迟抵消，且更受关注的事项更有可能在上诉中被推翻。一个聚束分析估计总时间节省约为4%，表明非货币杠杆即使在高度隔离的精英专业人士中也能改变行为。

records.title_en: Do information and communication technologies empower female workers? Evidence from Vietnam
records.title_cn: 信息和通信技术是否赋能女性劳动者？来自越南的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) adoption on female employment outcomes in Vietnam using rich firm- and individual-level data. Our identification exploits exogenous variation in ICT access driven by geographic connectivity conditions and a nationwide network upgrade in 2007. We find that ICT adoption increases the female share of employment within firms, primarily through within-firm reallocation in the formal sector. We further provide evidence consistent with a task-reallocation channel: ICT is associated with a shift in labor demand away from routine and manual tasks toward social, customer-based, and service-oriented activities, where women are more likely to have a comparative advantage.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用丰富的企业层面和个人层面数据，研究了信息和通信技术（ICT）的采用对越南女性就业结果的影响。我们的识别策略利用了由地理连通性条件和2007年全国网络升级所驱动的ICT接入的外生变化。我们发现，ICT的采用提高了企业内女性就业份额，这主要通过正规部门内的企业内重新配置实现。我们进一步提供了与任务重新配置渠道一致的证据：ICT与劳动力需求从常规性和体力任务转向社交性、客户导向和服务导向活动的变化相关，而女性在这些活动中更可能具有比较优势。

records.title_en: Friends with drugs: The role of social networks in the opioid epidemic
records.title_cn: 毒品之友：社交网络在阿片类药物流行中的作用
records.abstract_en: The current opioid epidemic is the worst drug epidemic the U.S. has ever faced. We examine the role of social connections in its spatial spread. Having many friendship links to counties with high opioid exposure positively correlates with overdose death rates. To address identification concerns, we exploit two quasi-natural experiments that led users to substitute illicit opioids for prescription drugs. Having more friends exposed to counties affected by these shocks leads to more overdose deaths. We also provide suggestive evidence that spillovers affect different stages of addiction, are influenced by both supply- and demand-side conditions, and are attenuated in counties with more cohesive local friendship networks. Our results show how social connections contribute to the spread of the opioid epidemic.
records.abstract_cn: 当前的阿片类药物流行是美国有史以来最严重的毒品流行。我们考察了社会联系在其空间传播中的作用。与阿片类药物暴露水平高的县有大量友谊联系的地区，其过量死亡率和这些联系呈正相关。为解决识别问题，我们利用了两个准自然实验，这些实验导致使用者从处方药转向非法阿片类药物。与受这些冲击影响的县有更多朋友接触的地区，过量死亡人数更多。我们还提供了提示性证据，表明溢出效应影响成瘾的不同阶段，受供给和需求两方面条件的影响，并且在本地友谊网络更紧密的县中，这种效应会减弱。我们的研究结果表明，社会联系如何促进阿片类药物流行的传播。

records.title_en: How to fund nonprofits?
records.title_cn: 如何为非营利组织提供资金？
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the optimal combination of government grants that provide direct public funding to nonprofits and tax incentives that reduce the cost of charitable giving. When nonprofits face high fundraising costs to attract donors, tax incentives cannot fully replace grants, which remain part of the optimal funding policy. When fundraising costs are sufficiently low, a government that can tailor tax incentives across causes can finance some causes entirely through donations. However, when cause-specific tax differentiation is unavailable, grants remain necessary to accommodate differences in funding needs across causes. In a calibrated example, imposing a uniform tax treatment of donations across charitable causes raises the optimal share of nonprofit funding covered by grants from 0 to 60%.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了政府拨款（为非营利组织提供直接公共资金）与税收激励（降低慈善捐赠成本）的最优组合。当非营利组织面临高昂的筹款成本以吸引捐赠者时，税收激励无法完全替代拨款，拨款仍是最优资金政策的一部分。当筹款成本足够低时，能够针对不同事业定制税收激励的政府可以完全通过捐赠为某些事业提供资金。然而，当无法针对特定事业进行税收差异化时，拨款仍然是必要的，以适应不同事业之间资金需求的差异。在一个校准示例中，对慈善事业实行统一的捐赠税收待遇，将拨款覆盖的非营利组织资金最优份额从0提高到60%。

records.title_en: Safety net payment digitization and participant outcomes: Evidence from the WIC EBT transition
records.title_cn: 安全网支付数字化与参与者结果：来自WIC EBT转型的证据
records.abstract_en: Can digital technologies improve the efficiency of social safety net programs? This paper examines the impact of digitizing payments in the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) on participant outcomes. We hand-collect the rollout schedule of payment digitization and link it to WIC participation and birth outcomes across multiple datasets. We find that WIC participation increases and birth outcomes improve among mothers exposed to digitization. Suggestive evidence indicates that payment digitization raises WIC participation by increasing awareness of the program and reducing stigma at the point of purchase, and that higher participation may, in turn, improve birth outcomes by increasing health insurance enrollment. Our back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that payment digitization is fiscally appealing, with a marginal value of public funds of 0.94. These findings can inform evaluations of further digitization in safety net programs, such as online redemption.
records.abstract_cn: 数字技术能否提高社会安全网项目的效率？本文考察了妇女、婴儿和儿童特别补充营养计划（WIC）中支付数字化对参与者结果的影响。我们手工收集了支付数字化的推广时间表，并将其与多个数据集中的WIC参与和出生结果相关联。我们发现，在接触数字化的母亲中，WIC参与率提高，出生结果改善。提示性证据表明，支付数字化通过提高项目认知度和减少购买时的污名感来增加WIC参与，而更高的参与率可能通过增加健康保险注册来改善出生结果。我们的粗略计算表明，支付数字化在财政上具有吸引力，公共资金的边际价值为0.94。这些发现可以为安全网项目中进一步数字化（如在线兑换）的评估提供信息。

records.title_en: Escaping temporary traps? Evidence from age-based incentives to permanent employment
records.title_cn: 逃离临时陷阱？基于年龄的永久就业激励证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how reducing the cost differential between permanent and temporary contracts affects firms’ use of each contract type. We analyze a 1997 Spanish reform that lowered non-wage labor costs for new open-ended (OE) contracts for workers under 30 and over 45, while leaving short-term (ST) contracts unaffected. Exploiting sectoral exposure and age-based discontinuities, we show that firms substitute strongly from ST to OE contracts for young workers but respond little for older workers. We find partial wage incidence of the subsidy on directly affected permanent jobs. The implied elasticity of substitution between ST and OE contracts is 6.5 for workers below age 30 and close to zero for workers above age 45. We also document that young workers’ wages rise in unsubsidized ST jobs consistent with the expansion of OE employment strengthening their outside options. Overall, the results reveal sharp age asymmetries in contract substitution. They suggest that monetary incentives can facilitate transitions from temporary to permanent employment for young workers, but are less effective for workers above age 45.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了降低永久合同与临时合同之间的成本差异如何影响企业对每种合同类型的使用。我们分析了1997年西班牙的一项改革，该改革降低了为30岁以下和45岁以上工人新签开放式（OE）合同的非工资劳动力成本，而短期（ST）合同不受影响。利用部门暴露和基于年龄的不连续性，我们表明企业强烈地从ST合同转向OE合同以雇佣年轻工人，但对老年工人的反应很小。我们发现补贴对直接受影响的永久性工作岗位存在部分工资归宿。对于30岁以下的工人，ST与OE合同之间的隐含替代弹性为6.5，而对于45岁以上的工人则接近于零。我们还记录了年轻工人在未获补贴的ST工作中的工资上涨，这与OE就业的扩张增强了他们的外部选择权相一致。总体而言，结果揭示了合同替代中显著的年龄不对称性。它们表明，货币激励可以促进年轻工人从临时就业向永久就业的转变，但对45岁以上的工人效果较差。

records.title_en: The effects of education on corruption: Evidence from Vietnam’s university expansion
records.title_cn: 教育对腐败的影响：来自越南大学扩张的证据
records.abstract_en: Education and corruption are negatively correlated at the cross-national level, but little is known about the causal relationship between the two. We combine newly-collected data on timing and locations of Vietnam’s national expansion of universities with detailed survey data on experiences of corruption from over 170,000 respondents in 320 districts across 12 years. Using staggered difference-in-differences, we show that cohorts exposed to the university expansion are 87% more likely to have a university education. However, this increase neither translates into fewer individuals being affected by corruption nor increases the propensity to denounce corrupt officials. Instead, we find that education increases the incidence of bribe requests and perceptions of corruption. The mechanism most consistent with our data is that higher education raises household income, and that the associated rise in the opportunity cost of time and in exposure to bribe-prone situations increases exposure to corruption.
records.abstract_cn: 教育与腐败在跨国层面上呈负相关，但关于两者之间的因果关系知之甚少。我们将新收集的越南全国大学扩张的时间和地点数据与来自170,000名受访者、320个地区、跨越12年的详细腐败经历调查数据相结合。使用交错双重差分法，我们表明暴露于大学扩张的队列获得大学教育的可能性高出87%。然而，这种增加既没有转化为受腐败影响的个人减少，也没有增加举报腐败官员的倾向。相反，我们发现教育增加了贿赂请求的发生率和腐败感知。与我们的数据最一致的机制是，高等教育提高了家庭收入，而随之而来的时间机会成本和暴露于易受贿赂情境的增加，增加了腐败暴露的风险。

records.title_en: Mortality regressivity and pension design
records.title_cn: 死亡率回归性与养老金设计
records.abstract_en: Should public policies address inequality due to heterogeneous life expectancy? Intuitively, taking a short life as a disadvantage, such policies should favor those with high mortality. Yet, pension systems implicitly redistribute from low-life-expectancy to high-life-expectancy people. Moreover, this direction of redistribution is optimal from the perspective of the standard utilitarian welfare criterion. We study mortality-related redistribution in a more flexible setting. We start by establishing a formal framework for the analysis by clearly distinguishing between redistribution along the mortality and income dimensions. We then characterize the conditions under which it is optimal to redistribute toward high-mortality people. One such condition is that the welfare criterion must feature an aversion to lifetime inequality that exceeds the aversion to consumption inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 公共政策是否应解决因预期寿命异质性导致的不平等？直觉上，将短寿命视为劣势，此类政策应偏向死亡率高的人群。然而，养老金体系却隐性地从低预期寿命人群向高预期寿命人群进行再分配。此外，这种再分配方向在标准功利主义福利准则下是最优的。我们在更灵活的框架下研究死亡率相关的再分配。我们首先通过明确区分沿死亡率和收入维度的再分配，建立正式的分析框架。然后，我们刻画了向高死亡率人群再分配为最优的条件。其中一个条件是，福利准则必须包含对终身不平等的厌恶程度超过对消费不平等的厌恶程度。

records.title_en: Election results and democratic discontent: Expectations, extremism, and democratic values in post-election Brazil
records.title_cn: 选举结果与民主不满：巴西大选后的期望、极端主义与民主价值观
records.abstract_en: I study how economic expectation shocks induced by elections contribute to democratic discontent in polarized societies, focusing on the 2022 Brazilian presidential election. Using newly collected survey data, I investigate how respondents’ expectations and attitudes toward democracy evolved after the opposition candidate’s narrow victory. By resurveying respondents post-election, I show that losing polarized voters who overestimate their candidate’s chances of winning experience a large negative economic expectation shock, as well as an increase in their anti-democratic sentiment. In an additional survey experiment, I provide causal evidence that this shock is a driver of democratic discontent, by showing that positively updating respondents’ economic expectations reduces their anti-democratic sentiment.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了选举引发的经济预期冲击如何在极化社会中导致民主不满，重点关注2022年巴西总统选举。利用新收集的调查数据，我调查了在反对派候选人以微弱优势获胜后，受访者的期望和对民主的态度如何演变。通过对受访者进行选举后重新调查，我表明，那些高估其候选人获胜机会的失利的极化选民经历了巨大的负面经济预期冲击，以及其反民主情绪的增加。在额外的调查实验中，我通过展示积极更新受访者的经济预期会减少其反民主情绪，提供了因果证据表明这种冲击是民主不满的一个驱动因素。

records.title_en: The role of escape clauses: Firm response to thin capitalization rules
records.title_cn: 豁免条款的作用：企业对资本弱化规则的反应
records.abstract_en: Multinational firms can use internal debt to shift taxable income across jurisdictions. To limit such profit shifting and protect the corporate tax base, many countries use thin capitalization rules that restrict interest deductibility. These rules often include escape clauses that exempt firms below specified thresholds, but such thresholds may create incentives for avoidance within corporate groups. This paper evaluates Norway’s 2014 thin capitalization rule using difference-in-differences, bunching, and regression discontinuity designs. We find that exposed firms sharply reduce leverage after the reform, driven by lower intra-group borrowing and interest costs, with no detectable effects on firm performance. At the corporate-group level, leverage remains unchanged, indicating that firm-level responses primarily reflect intra-group debt reallocation. We document substantial bunching below the rule’s exemption thresholds, especially among newly created subsidiaries, and show that internal debt is disproportionately shifted to these bunching firms. Although firms eliminate most of their initial exposure to the rule itself, this happens largely through reduced internal lending, and we find suggestive evidence of higher taxable income in the medium run. Because we observe only the Norwegian parts of multinational groups, we cannot provide conclusive evidence on cross-border profit shifting. Overall, the findings show that firm-level escape clauses generate strategic avoidance responses within corporate groups, while also suggesting that the reform may have protected the Norwegian tax base.
records.abstract_cn: 跨国企业可以利用内部债务在不同司法管辖区之间转移应税收入。为了限制这种利润转移并保护企业所得税税基，许多国家采用资本弱化规则来限制利息扣除。这些规则通常包含豁免条款，允许低于特定门槛的企业免于适用，但此类门槛可能在企业集团内部产生规避激励。本文利用双重差分法、聚束法和断点回归设计评估了挪威的2014资本弱化规则。我们发现，受影响的公司在改革后显著降低了杠杆率，这主要是由于集团内部借款和利息成本的下降，且未对公司绩效产生可检测的影响。在企业集团层面，杠杆率保持不变，表明公司层面的反应主要反映了集团内部债务的重新配置。我们记录了在规则豁免门槛下方的大量聚束现象，尤其是在新设立的子公司中，并表明内部债务不成比例地转移到了这些聚束企业。尽管企业消除了其对规则本身的大部分初始敞口，但这主要通过减少内部贷款实现，并且我们发现了中期应税收入提高的提示性证据。由于我们仅观察到跨国集团的挪威部分，无法就跨境利润转移提供确凿证据。总体而言，研究结果表明，公司层面的豁免条款在企业集团内部引发了战略性规避反应，同时也表明该改革可能保护了挪威的税基。

records.title_en: Language and identity: Evidence from a schooling reform
records.title_cn: 语言与身份认同：来自一项学校教育改革的证据
records.abstract_en: Governments have long imposed a common language of schooling on linguistic minorities in the hope of forging a shared national identity, yet whether such mandates integrate minorities or provoke backlash remains contested. We study Quebec’s 1977 Charter of the French Language, which required younger cohorts of immigrant children to enroll in French instead of English schools. Using a difference-in-differences estimation strategy we compare cohorts required to be schooled in French with those exempted from the requirement. We find that two to four decades later, children who were required to attend French schools were more likely to adopt French as a home language and less likely to adopt English, with part of the shift away from English going to heritage languages rather than to French. These shifts in language carry over to changes in identity and political attitudes: treated cohorts are more likely to identify as Québécois or French-Canadian, less attached to Canada, and more supportive of Quebec independence. We find no robust evidence of effects on education or income, and no evidence of cultural or political backlash among those who remained in Quebec. The clearest resistance took the form of exit, as treated families were twice as likely to leave the province.
records.abstract_cn: 政府长期以来对语言少数群体强制推行统一的学校教育语言，以期塑造共同的民族认同，然而此类强制措施究竟是促进融合还是引发反弹，仍存在争议。我们研究了魁北克省的1977《法语宪章》，该宪章要求较年轻的移民子女群体就读法语学校而非英语学校。采用双重差分估计策略，我们将被要求接受法语教育的群体与豁免该要求的群体进行比较。我们发现，在二至四十年后，被要求就读法语学校的儿童更可能将法语作为家庭语言，而更不可能采用英语，其中部分从英语的转变流向了传统语言而非法语。这些语言转变进一步影响了身份认同和政治态度：受处理群体更可能认同为魁北克人或法裔加拿大人，对加拿大的依恋程度较低，且更支持魁北克独立。我们未发现对教育或收入产生影响的稳健证据，也未发现留在魁北克的群体中出现文化或政治反弹的证据。最明显的抵制形式是退出，受处理家庭离开该省的可能性是其他家庭的两倍。

records.title_en: Benefit-based taxation can include substantial redistribution
records.title_cn: 基于受益的税收可以包含实质性的再分配
records.abstract_en: Contrary to a long-standing concern, we present evidence that classical benefit-based labor income taxation in the tradition of Smith (1776) is consistent with income redistribution through transfers and negative average tax rates both theoretically and—in plausibly-specified simulations—quantitatively, at levels which reflect U.S. policy over the past several decades. As redistribution is widespread in practice, our results remove an obstacle to the benefit principle’s plausibility as a prevailing normative foundation of tax policy.
records.abstract_cn: 与长期以来的担忧相反，我们提供的证据表明，遵循斯密（1776）传统的经典基于受益的劳动收入税收，在理论上与通过转移支付和负平均税率进行的收入再分配相一致，并且在合理设定的模拟中，其数量水平反映了美国过去几十年的政策。由于再分配在实践中广泛存在，我们的结果消除了受益原则作为税收政策主流规范基础的可信度障碍。

records.title_en: From prison peers to co-offenders
records.title_cn: 从狱友到共同犯罪者
records.abstract_en: This paper provides direct evidence that shared incarceration can facilitate the formation of post-release criminal partnerships. Using Norwegian administrative data linking prison spells to police case identifiers, we measure network ties through subsequent co-offending. We exploit time-based variation in exposure within facilities by comparing inmate pairs in the same facility who differ only in whether their spells overlapped. Overlap is associated with a 37% increase in five-year co-offending relative to comparable non-overlapping pairs, robust to extensive controls and timing-based restrictions. Effects are stronger in environments and for pairs where interaction is plausibly more intense, highlighting network formation as a plausible mechanism.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了直接证据表明，共同监禁可以促进释放后犯罪伙伴关系的形成。利用挪威行政数据将监狱服刑期与警方案件标识符相关联，我们通过随后的共同犯罪行为来衡量网络联系。我们利用设施内接触的时间变化，比较同一设施中仅在服刑期是否重叠上有所不同的囚犯配对。与可比较的非重叠配对相比，重叠与五年内共同犯罪率增加37%相关，这一结果在广泛的控制变量和基于时间的限制下依然稳健。在互动可能更密集的环境和配对中，效应更强，这突显了网络形成作为一种合理的机制。

records.title_en: Do prosecutor and defendant race pairings matter? Evidence from random assignment
records.title_cn: 检察官与被告的种族配对是否重要？来自随机分配的证据
records.abstract_en: Racial disparities in criminal justice outcomes are well documented. However, there is little evidence on whether the pairing of prosecutors and defendants contributes to these disparities. This paper tests for race-pairing effects in convictions by prosecutors. I leverage conditionally as-good-as-random assignment of misdemeanor cases using administrative data from New York County’s Early Case Assessment Bureau. I find little evidence of race-pairing effects overall or for drug, person, and other offenses. In contrast, I find a robust 5 percentage point (8 percent) race-pairing effect for property crimes. The underlying pattern is driven by differences in outcomes for Black defendants, while conviction rates for White defendants are nearly identical across prosecutor race. Results appear driven by reduced use of adjournments in contemplation of dismissal, a discretionary form of prosecutorial leniency.
records.abstract_cn: 刑事司法结果中的种族差异已有充分记录。然而，关于检察官与被告的配对是否导致这些差异的证据很少。本文检验了检察官定罪中的种族配对效应。我利用纽约县早期案件评估局的行政数据，对轻罪案件进行了条件上近似随机的分配。总体而言，我几乎没有发现种族配对效应的证据，无论是毒品、人身还是其他犯罪。相比之下，我发现财产犯罪存在稳健的5个百分点（8%）的种族配对效应。这一潜在模式是由黑人被告结果的差异驱动的，而白人被告的定罪率在不同种族的检察官之间几乎相同。结果似乎是由减少使用延期驳回（一种检察官自由裁量的宽大处理形式）所驱动的。

records.title_en: Central banker to the world: Foreign reserve management and U.S. money market liquidity
records.title_cn: 央行行长对世界：外汇储备管理和美国货币市场流动性
records.abstract_en: We develop a model that shows how foreign reserve management decisions can adversely affect U.S. money market liquidity. Consistent with the March 2020 dash-for-cash, our model suggests that as export-price volatility increases, a foreign central bank that pegs its exchange rate shifts reserves from relatively illiquid Treasuries to the Fed’s reverse repo facility. Over the relevant horizon, this precautionary behavior drains liquidity from U.S. money markets and raises repo spreads. These predictions provide a credible channel to identify the effect of foreign central bank demand for dollar liquidity on repo spreads, exploiting the characteristics of commodity exporters with pegged exchange rates. Empirical evidence supports the model’s predictions: precautionary sales by these central banks lead to a statistically and economically significant widening of repo spreads, accompanied by a drawdown in Treasury balances. These results underscore how the Fed’s foreign-repo facilities mitigate global dollar-funding stress and protect U.S. short-term funding markets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个模型，展示外汇储备管理决策如何对美国货币市场流动性产生不利影响。与三月2020抢现金一致，我们的模型表明，随着出口价格波动性的增加，钉住汇率的外国央行会将储备从流动性相对较差的国债转移到美联储的逆回购工具。在相关范围内，这种预防性行为会耗尽美国货币市场的流动性并提高回购利差。这些预测利用钉住汇率的大宗商品出口国的特点，为确定外国央行对美元流动性的需求对回购利差的影响提供了可靠的渠道。经验证据支持该模型的预测：这些央行的预防性出售导致回购利差在统计上和经济上显着扩大，并伴随着国债余额的减少。这些结果凸显了美联储的外国回购设施如何缓解全球美元融资压力并保护美国短期融资市场。

records.title_en: Playing with blocs: Quantifying decoupling
records.title_cn: 玩弄集团：量化脱钩
records.abstract_en: We adopt a data-driven approach to measure trade decoupling over 2015-2023. Countries are classified into three groups according to changes in their data-inferred trade costs with the US and China: those shifting toward the US bloc, those shifting toward the China bloc, and those with no change in alignment. We document that while cross-bloc trade costs rose, they were accompanied by falling within-bloc trade costs, with average trade costs falling marginally in line with global trade resilience. We use a quantitative model to compute the real income effects of this reconfiguration of trade costs. Model simulations suggest that real income in the median country in the world, and the median country within each bloc, rose by 0.4-0.6%. Finally, we find a modest amount of bloc misalignment: the median country would be better off switching blocs. These results suggest that trade decoupling may not follow trade-driven economic interests.
records.abstract_cn: 我们采用数据驱动的方法来衡量2015-2023期间的贸易脱钩。根据数据推断的与美国和中国的贸易成本变化，各国被分为三组：转向美国集团的国家、转向中国集团的国家以及没有变化的国家。我们记录到，虽然跨集团贸易成本上升，但伴随着集团内贸易成本下降，平均贸易成本略有下降，与全球贸易弹性一致。我们使用定量模型来计算贸易成本重新配置的实际收入影响。模型模拟表明，世界上中等国家以及每个集团内中等国家的实际收入增长了0.4-0.6%。最后，我们发现了一定程度的集团失调：中间国家最好切换集团。这些结果表明，贸易脱钩可能并不遵循贸易驱动的经济利益。

records.title_en: Seizing central bank assets?
records.title_cn: 扣押央行资产？
records.abstract_en: We study the global impacts of sanctions on central bank assets. We build a database on freezes and seizures of central bank assets spanning 1914–2024. We show that the scale of the freeze on today’s Central Bank of Russia’s assets is rarely seen in history and that non-belligerent countries have never seized central bank assets to finance reconstruction in a third country in an ongoing war. We propose a three-country DSGE model to understand the global impacts of sanctions on central bank assets and tease out the macroeconomic mechanisms. One insight of the model is that seizing central bank assets can result in adverse effects on the sanctioning country in general equilibrium. Calibrated model simulations suggest that seizing Russia’s immobilized sovereign assets could result in higher interest rates on sanctioning countries’ government bonds. The increase in interest rate payments could surpass the assets’ amount seized after about three years.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究制裁对央行资产的全球影响。我们建立了一个关于1914-2024央行资产冻结和扣押的数据库。我们表明，当今俄罗斯中央银行资产冻结的规模在历史上是罕见的，并且非交战国家从未在第三国家的持续战争中没收中央银行资产来为重建提供资金。我们提出了一个三国家 DSGE 模型，以了解制裁对央行资产的全球影响并梳理宏观经济机制。 一该模型的见解是，扣押央行资产可能会对处于一般均衡状态的制裁国造成不利影响。校准模型模拟表明，扣押俄罗斯的固定主权资产可能会导致制裁国政府债券的利率上升。大约三年后，利率支付的增加可能超过扣押的资产金额。

records.title_en: Trade fragmentation, inflationary pressures and monetary policy
records.title_cn: 贸易碎片化、通胀压力和货币政策
records.abstract_en: How does trade fragmentation affect inflationary pressures? What is the response of monetary policy needed to sustain inflation at target? To address these questions, we develop a two-sector, small open-economy model that features imperfect international risk-sharing and household heterogeneity, capturing both the supply-side and demand-side effects of fragmentation. In the model, fragmentation takes the form of import-price increases or a decline in tradable-sector productivity. The sign and magnitude of its impact on inflationary pressures, and the appropriate policy response, depend not only on the direct effect of higher import prices or lower productivity on supply but also, crucially, on how aggregate demand adjusts to lower real incomes. In turn, this depends on the pace of fragmentation (gradual versus front-loaded) and other key structural factors highlighted by the model. We compare outcomes under Taylor-type monetary policy rules to a constrained-efficient allocation.
records.abstract_cn: 贸易碎片化如何影响通胀压力？维持通胀目标所需的货币政策有何反应？为了解决这些问题，我们开发了一个二部门小型开放经济模型，该模型具有不完善的国际风险分担和家庭异质性，捕捉了碎片化的供给侧和需求侧影响。在该模型中，碎片化表现为进口价格上涨或可贸易部门生产率下降。其对通胀压力影响的迹象和程度，以及适当的政策反应，不仅取决于进口价格上涨或生产率下降对供给的直接影响，而且最重要的是，取决于总需求如何适应实际收入的下降。反过来，这取决于碎片化的速度（渐进与提前）以及模型强调的其他关键结构因素。我们将泰勒型货币政策规则下的结果与受限有效配置进行比较。

records.title_en: Granularity in the current account
records.title_cn: 经常账户的粒度
records.abstract_en: We present new empirical evidence on the role of granularity in the current account (CA), using a unique and comprehensive firm-level dataset for Switzerland. We show that idiosyncratic shocks to large firms account for almost two thirds of the fluctuations in the headline CA and are the primary source of CA volatility. The granular effect is present across goods, services, and income components and persists over both short- and medium-term horizons. In addition to their direct impact, idiosyncratic shocks propagate through inter-firm linkages via input–output relationships and cross-product connections associated with multinational enterprise activity. Our findings complement standard macroeconomic models by providing a micro-founded perspective and demonstrating the importance of granularity in explaining fluctuations in external balances.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用瑞士独特且全面的企业级数据集，提出了关于粒度在经常账户 (CA) 中的作用的新经验证据。我们表明，大公司的特殊冲击几乎占总体 CA 波动的二三分之一，并且是 CA 波动的主要来源。这种颗粒效应存在于商品、服务和收入组成部分，并在短期和中期持续存在。除了直接影响之外，特殊冲击还通过与跨国企业活动相关的投入产出关系和跨产品联系通过公司间联系传播。我们的研究结果通过提供微观视角并证明粒度在解释外部平衡波动方面的重要性，补充了标准宏观经济模型。

records.title_en: A nascent international financial channel of China’s monetary policy transmission
records.title_cn: 中国货币政策传导的新兴国际金融渠道
records.abstract_en: Chinese portfolio equity outflows grew significantly over time due to capital account liberalization. Using matched stock-fund holding data under the Qualified Domestic Institutional Investor (QDII) program, we identify a nascent financial channel of international transmission of Chinese monetary policy to world stock markets. Event studies around monetary policy announcement days uncover a cross-sectional differential impact: returns on MSCI indexes and U.S. stocks with QDII exposure are more responsive than those of non-exposed ones. The effects are driven by smaller, less liquid, and lower-turnover stocks, but not by China-concept stocks, or those exposed to mainland macroeconomic shocks. We also provide evidence consistent with a retail-driven portfolio-rebalancing mechanism: tightening periods are associated with outflows from QDII funds with high equity portfolio shares that fund managers do not fully offset. Retail flows also seem more closely associated with monetary policy changes than institutional flows.
records.abstract_cn: 由于资本账户自由化，中国投资组合股票流出随着时间的推移大幅增长。利用合格境内机构投资者（QDII）计划下的匹配股票基金持有数据，我们确定了中国货币政策向世界股票市场国际传导的新兴金融渠道。围绕货币政策公布日的事件研究揭示了横截面的差异影响：MSCI 指数和具有 QDII 敞口的美国股票的回报比非敞口的股票的反应更灵敏。这些影响是由规模较小、流动性较差和换手率较低的股票推动的，而不是由中国概念股或受到大陆宏观经济冲击的股票推动的。我们还提供了与散户驱动的投资组合再平衡机制相一致的证据：紧缩期与 QDII 基金的资金流出相关，这些基金拥有高股票投资组合份额，而基金经理并未完全抵消这些资金。与机构流动相比，零售流动似乎与货币政策变化的关系更为密切。

records.title_en: Covered interest parity in emerging markets: Measurement and drivers
records.title_cn: 新兴市场的备兑利率平价：衡量标准和驱动因素
records.abstract_en: We study the behavior of Covered Interest Parity (CIP) deviations – aka the CIP basis – in Emerging Markets (EM). A major challenge in computing the CIP basis in EM’s lies in measuring local currency interest rates which are free of local credit risk and market segmentation. To do so, we construct a ‘purified’ CIP basis for eight major EM currencies using supranational bonds issued in EM local currencies and US dollar going back twenty years. We show that this ‘purified’ CIP basis aligns well with theory-implied predictions. In the cross-section and the time-series, the basis correlates with fundamental forces driving supply and demand for dollar forwards. Shocks to global dollar funding costs, global intermediary’s balance sheet capacity, and the demand for dollar safe assets interact with currency-specific dollar hedging and funding needs in moving the CIP basis in EM’s.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究新兴市场 (EM) 的备兑利率平价 (CIP) 偏差（又称 CIP 基础）的行为。计算新兴市场 CIP 基础的一个主要挑战在于衡量不受当地信用风险和市场分割影响的当地货币利率。为此，我们利用二十年前以新兴市场本币和美元发行的超国家债券，为八主要新兴市场货币构建了一个“纯净”的CIP基础。我们表明，这种“纯化的”CIP 基础与理论隐含的预测非常吻合。在横截面和时间序列中，基差与驱动美元远期供需的基本力量相关。全球美元融资成本、全球中介机构资产负债表能力的冲击以及对美元安全资产的需求与特定货币的美元对冲和融资需求相互作用，从而影响了新兴市场的 CIP 基础。

records.title_en: How to grow an invoicing currency: Micro evidence from Argentina
records.title_cn: 如何发展计价货币：来自阿根廷的微观证据
records.abstract_en: We study the internationalization of the Chinese renminbi (RMB) leveraging a unique policy experiment. In 2023, amid a dollar shortage, Argentina expanded a currency swap line with China. The share of imports from China invoiced in RMB surged rapidly, displacing the dollar, which had previously accounted for virtually all invoicing. Following the presidential election of late 2023, as the dollar shortage eased, invoicing in RMB declined. We explore the mechanisms behind this pattern, using firm-level data on imports, bank-firm loan relationships, and bank balance sheets. We find that banks played a key role. Firms with pre-existing relationships to banks with limited US dollar loans were more likely to switch to RMB. In addition, firms borrowing from a Chinese state-owned bank were more likely to use RMB. We also document firm-level spillovers, with RMB use for imports from China increasing RMB use for imports from other countries. Finally, firms switching to RMB saw increased total imports.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用独特的政策实验研究人民币（RMB）的国际化。 2023，在美元短缺的情况下，阿根廷扩大了与中国的货币互换额度。以人民币计价的中国进口商品份额迅速飙升，取代了此前几乎全部以美元计价的美元。在最近的总统选举2023之后，随着美元短缺的缓解，人民币计价有所下降。我们利用企业层面的进口数据、银企贷款关系和银行资产负债表来探索这种模式背后的机制。我们发现银行发挥了关键作用。与美元贷款有限的银行已有关系的公司更有可能转向人民币。此外，从中国国有银行借款的企业更有可能使用人民币。我们还记录了企业层面的溢出效应，从中国进口的人民币使用增加了从其他国家进口的人民币使用。最后，转向人民币的企业看到进口总额增加。

records.title_en: Strategic communication among banks
records.title_cn: 银行间的战略沟通
records.abstract_en: How do bank networks facilitate information flows that shape market outcomes? Using international banks’ advisory activities in corporate takeovers as their source of private information, we show in supervisory data that banks with closer ties to the target, but not the acquirer, advisor trade profitably in the target’s stock prior to the deal announcement. This trading behavior is associated with a higher premium paid without compromising deal success. As connected banks’ incentives are aligned only with target shareholders’ interests, which are represented by the target advisor, our evidence suggests that economic incentives determine which banks share information and with whom.
records.abstract_cn: 银行网络如何促进信息流动，从而影响市场结果？利用国际银行在公司收购中的咨询活动作为其私人信息来源，我们在监管数据中显示，与目标公司顾问关系更紧密的银行，而非收购方顾问，在交易公告前会利用目标公司的股票进行盈利性交易。这种交易行为与支付更高的溢价相关，且不影响交易成功。由于关联银行的激励仅与目标公司股东的利益一致，而这些利益由目标顾问代表，我们的证据表明，经济激励决定了哪些银行分享信息以及与谁分享。

records.title_en: Private equity for pension plans? Evaluating private equity performance from an investor’s perspective
records.title_cn: 养老金计划的私募股权？从投资者视角评估私募股权表现
records.abstract_en: We evaluate private equity (PE) performance using investor-specific stochastic discount factors, and examine whether public pension plans could benefit from changing their allocation to PE. Plans invest in PE funds with higher than average risk-adjusted performance. This is mainly due to access to successful managers, not superior selection skill. Decomposing returns into risk-compensation and “alpha”, we find that some plans obtain higher PE returns by taking more risk without earning higher, and in some cases earning lower, risk-adjusted returns, broadly consistent with agency problems within plans.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用投资者特定的随机贴现因子评估私募股权（PE）表现，并考察公共养老金计划是否可以通过改变其对PE的配置而受益。计划投资于风险调整后表现高于平均水平的PE基金。这主要归因于接触成功经理人的机会，而非卓越的选择技能。将回报分解为风险补偿和“阿尔法”后，我们发现一些计划通过承担更多风险获得更高的PE回报，但并未获得更高的风险调整后回报，在某些情况下甚至获得更低的风险调整后回报，这与计划内部的代理问题大体一致。

records.title_en: Short versus long-run demand elasticities in asset pricing
records.title_cn: 资产定价中的短期与长期需求弹性
records.abstract_en: This paper quantifies how investors’ portfolio demand responds to price changes at long horizons versus short horizons. Using investor trades – changes in portfolios – at different horizons, I first present reduced-form evidence that elasticities increase significantly over time. I then propose a dynamic demand system via a parsimonious partial-adjustment model that recovers the full term structure of elasticities while mitigating long-horizon identification challenges. The estimates imply that price impacts are three times larger at quarterly horizons than in the long-run equilibrium. The model produces a novel, stock-level measure of long-term reversal that avoids the noise of long-horizon return regressions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文量化了投资者在不同时间跨度（长期与短期）下投资组合需求对价格变化的响应。利用不同时间跨度的投资者交易——即投资组合的变化——我首先提供了简化形式的证据，表明弹性随时间显著增加。随后，我通过一个简约的部分调整模型提出了一个动态需求系统，该模型能够恢复弹性的完整期限结构，同时缓解长期识别挑战。估计结果表明，在季度时间跨度上的价格影响比长期均衡中的大三倍。该模型产生了一种新颖的、股票层面的长期反转度量，避免了长期回报回归中的噪声问题。

records.title_en: Can ChatGPT forecast stock price movements? Return predictability and large language models
records.title_cn: ChatGPT能否预测股价走势？收益可预测性与大型语言模型
records.abstract_en: We document the capability of large language models (LLMs) like ChatGPT to predict stock market reactions from news headlines without direct financial training. Using post-knowledge-cutoff headlines, GPT-4 captures initial market responses, achieving approximately 90% portfolio-day hit rates for the non-tradable initial reaction. GPT-4 scores also significantly predict the subsequent drift, especially for small stocks and negative news. Forecasting ability generally increases with model size, suggesting that financial reasoning is an emerging capacity of complex LLMs. Strategy returns decline as LLM adoption rises, consistent with improved price efficiency. To rationalize these findings, we develop a theoretical model that incorporates LLM technology, information-processing capacity constraints, underreaction, and limits to arbitrage.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了大型语言模型（LLMs）如ChatGPT在无需直接金融训练的情况下，从新闻标题预测股票市场反应的能力。使用知识截止日期后的标题，GPT-4捕捉了初始市场反应，对于不可交易的初始反应实现了约90%的投资组合日命中率。GPT-4评分也显著预测了随后的漂移，尤其是对于小盘股和负面新闻。预测能力通常随模型规模增大而增强，这表明金融推理是复杂LLMs的一种新兴能力。随着LLM采用的增加，策略回报下降，这与价格效率提高一致。为了合理化这些发现，我们开发了一个理论模型，该模型整合了LLM技术、信息处理能力约束、反应不足和套利限制。

records.title_en: The passthrough of treasury supply to bank deposit funding
records.title_cn: 国债供给对银行存款融资的传导
records.abstract_en: We demonstrate the passthrough of Treasury supply to bank deposits through bank market power. We show that a larger Treasury supply crowds out deposits with disproportionate effects in more competitive deposit markets. A larger Treasury supply further curtails bank lending and affects bank funding structure. The explanatory power of Treasury supply is not driven by other shocks to deposit demand and supply. In comparison, monetary policy rate hikes have a larger impact on deposit funding in more concentrated markets, consistent with the deposits channel of monetary policy. Our empirical findings are rationalized in a model of imperfect deposit competition.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过银行市场势力展示了国债供给对银行存款的传导效应。我们发现，更大的国债供给会挤出存款，且在竞争更激烈的存款市场中影响尤为显著。更大的国债供给进一步减少了银行贷款，并影响银行的融资结构。国债供给的解释力并非由存款需求和供给的其他冲击所驱动。相比之下，货币政策利率上调在更集中的市场中对存款融资的影响更大，这与货币政策的存款渠道一致。我们的实证发现在一个不完全存款竞争模型中得到了合理化解释。

records.title_en: Institutional investor mandates, securities lending, and short-selling constraints
records.title_cn: 机构投资者授权、证券借贷与卖空约束
records.abstract_en: Institutions facilitate short-selling by lending from their holdings, but what they hold is endogenous. This paper examines how institutional demand, driven by investment mandates (benchmarking), affects short-selling. In a model where benchmarked managers lend from their holdings, both lending supply and equilibrium price are higher for the benchmark asset, and so is shorting demand (due to inflated price). A quasi-experiment using Russell index reconstitution shows that stocks with more benchmarked capital have greater lending supply and demand. Ultimately, such stocks are costlier to short. In theory and data, results are driven by incomplete pass-through from benchmarked capital to lending supply.
records.abstract_cn: 机构通过从其持有资产中借出证券来促进卖空，但其持有资产是内生的。本文考察了由投资授权（基准化）驱动的机构需求如何影响卖空。在一个基准化管理者从其持有资产中借出证券的模型中，基准资产的借贷供给和均衡价格均更高，卖空需求也因此更高（由于价格膨胀）。利用罗素指数重构的准实验表明，基准化资本更多的股票具有更大的借贷供给和需求。最终，这类股票的卖空成本更高。在理论和数据中，结果由基准化资本向借贷供给的不完全传导所驱动。

records.title_en: Convenience lost
records.title_cn: 便利收益的丧失
records.abstract_en: Using an instrument for U.S. Treasury supply, we show that convenience yields on medium- and long-term Treasurys are much more sensitive to supply than those on short-term Treasurys, which respond little. Over the past two decades, fiscal expansion has substantially reduced medium- and long-term convenience yields, at times pushing them below zero, while short-term convenience yields have declined toward zero. Quantitatively, we estimate that increased Treasury supply explains a large share of the secular decline in medium- and long-term convenience yields, lowering the total seigniorage revenue from Treasury issuance by about one-third.
records.abstract_cn: 利用美国国债供给的工具变量，我们表明中长期国债的便利收益对供给的敏感度远高于短期国债，后者反应甚微。在过去二十年中，财政扩张大幅降低了中长期便利收益，有时将其推至零以下，而短期便利收益则趋于零。在数量上，我们估计国债供给的增加解释了中长期便利收益长期下降的很大一部分，使国债发行的总铸币税收入降低了约三分之一。

records.title_en: Segmented Dollar Funding
records.title_cn: 分段美元融资
records.abstract_en: Deviations from covered interest rate parity (CIP) are often linked to limits to arbitrage, yet trading volumes surge during periods of apparent no-arbitrage violations. We show that these distortions stem from constraints on non-U.S. agents’ access to wholesale U.S. dollar markets and reflect a premium for unencumbered synthetic dollar funding: non-U.S. banks substitute secured USD borrowing with FX swaps to meet regulatory requirements. A shadow cost-augmented CIP condition holds, implying no riskless arbitrage. U.S. dealers extract rents on dollar provision while non-U.S. customers bear $10.4 billion in additional annual hedging costs. Our results illustrate how intermediary constraints segment global dollar funding.
records.abstract_cn: 覆盖利率平价（CIP）的偏离通常与套利限制相关，然而在明显的无套利违规时期，交易量却激增。我们表明，这些扭曲源于非美国主体进入美国批发美元市场的限制，并反映了无负担合成美元融资的溢价：非美国银行用外汇掉期替代有担保的美元借款以满足监管要求。一个包含影子成本的增强型CIP条件成立，意味着不存在无风险套利。美国交易商在提供美元时获取租金，而非美国客户则承担每年104亿美元的额外对冲成本。我们的结果说明了中介约束如何分割全球美元融资市场。

records.title_en: A New Keynesian model of the term structures of equity and bond returns
records.title_cn: 股票和债券收益率期限结构的新凯恩斯主义模型
records.abstract_en: A simple production economy with nominal price rigidities explains several key asset pricing facts, including the average slopes and cyclicality of equity and interest rate term structures. Nominal rigidities amplify the procyclicality of dividends after negative productivity shocks and generate countercyclical inflation, as sluggish price adjustment leads to a gradual dividend recovery. Consequently, short-duration equities (bonds) have more (less) procyclical payoffs than their long-duration counterparts. Slow-moving consumption habits produce large, countercyclical risk prices, yielding realistic asset valuations. Extending Campbell–Cochrane preferences with both market- and home-consumption habits allows them to operate in production economies while preserving realistic macroeconomic dynamics.
records.abstract_cn: 一个具有名义价格刚性的简单生产经济解释了几个关键的资产定价事实，包括股票和利率期限结构的平均斜率与周期性。名义刚性放大了负生产率冲击后股息的前瞻周期性，并产生反周期的通货膨胀，因为缓慢的价格调整导致股息逐渐恢复。因此，短期股票（债券）的支付比长期对应物更具（更不）前瞻周期性。缓慢移动的消费习惯产生大而反周期的风险价格，从而产生现实的资产估值。将Campbell–Cochrane偏好扩展到同时包含市场和家庭消费习惯，使它们能够在生产经济中运作，同时保持现实的宏观经济动态。

records.title_en: Macroprudential regulation and banks’ supply of liquidity services
records.title_cn: 宏观审慎监管与银行流动性服务供给
records.abstract_en: Are banks safer when they hold more safe assets? This paper builds a model in which banks supply liquidity services through uninsured deposits. Define a safe asset as an asset with both low payoff risk and high pledgeability. Banks consider equity costly and because of safe assets’ low payoff risk prefer to fund them largely with deposits. High pledgeability makes this feasible. The rise in banks’ deposit supply increases deposit rates and forces banks to deviate from socially desirable levels of capital to meet return-on-equity targets. Regulatory leverage ratios can be tightened to increase welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 当银行持有更多安全资产时，它们是否更安全？本文构建了一个模型，在该模型中，银行通过未投保存款提供流动性服务。将安全资产定义为具有低支付风险和高可质押性的资产。银行认为股权成本高昂，并且由于安全资产的低支付风险，倾向于主要用存款为其融资。高可质押性使这成为可能。银行存款供给的增加提高了存款利率，并迫使银行偏离社会合意的资本水平以满足股本回报率目标。可以收紧监管杠杆率以提高福利。

records.title_en: Do proprietary traders provide liquidity?
records.title_cn: 自营交易者是否提供流动性？
records.abstract_en: Whether proprietary traders provide or take liquidity, and how their behavior evolves over the business cycle and across stocks, remains at the center of an ongoing debate. Using a unique dataset from the NYSE, we document that proprietary traders act as net liquidity providers, buying after price declines in a contrarian pattern. Proprietary trader liquidity provision is concentrated in large, liquid, low-volatility stocks and diminishes significantly when intermediary balance sheets are weak. Liquidity provision is stronger when price movements are plausibly not driven by information. Our findings highlight both the role and the limits of proprietary traders in supporting market liquidity across time and market segments.
records.abstract_cn: 自营交易者究竟是提供还是吸收流动性，以及他们的行为如何随商业周期和股票的不同而演变，仍然是一场持续争论的核心。利用纽约证券交易所的独特数据集，我们记录了自营交易者作为净流动性提供者的行为，他们在价格下跌后以逆向模式买入。自营交易者的流动性提供集中在大型、流动性强、低波动性的股票中，并在中介机构资产负债表疲弱时显著减少。当价格变动可能并非由信息驱动时，流动性提供更为强劲。我们的发现凸显了自营交易者在跨时间和市场细分中支持市场流动性的作用及其局限性。

records.title_en: The Isolation index and variations on relative exposure
records.title_cn: 隔离指数与相对暴露度的变体
records.abstract_en: We provide an axiomatic characterization of the segregation order represented by the Isolation index, which is increasingly used by economists to measure segregation and related concepts. We extend this result to a broad family of segregation orders that includes the Atkinson and Entropy orders.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了由隔离指数所代表的隔离排序的公理化特征，该指数越来越多地被经济学家用于衡量隔离及相关概念。我们将这一结果扩展到包括阿特金森和熵排序在内的广泛隔离排序族。

records.title_en: Value of information in social learning
records.title_cn: 社会学习中的信息价值
records.abstract_en: This study extends Blackwell (1953) comparison of information to a sequential social learning model in which agents make decisions sequentially based on both private signals and observed actions of others. In this context, we introduce a binary relation over information structures: an information structure is more socially valuable than another if it yields higher expected payoffs for all agents, regardless of their preferences and equilibrium realizations. First, we establish that this binary relation is strictly stronger than the Blackwell order. Next, we provide a necessary and sufficient condition for our binary relation and propose a simpler sufficient condition that is easier to verify. We further explore comparisons of information structures in terms of long-run payoffs, limit welfare, and canonical binary environments.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究将Blackwell (1953)的信息比较扩展到序贯社会学习模型，在该模型中，代理人基于私人信号和观察到的他人行为依次做出决策。在此背景下，我们引入信息结构上的二元关系：如果一个信息结构对所有代理人产生更高的期望收益，无论其偏好和均衡实现如何，则该信息结构比另一个更具社会价值。首先，我们确定该二元关系严格强于Blackwell序。接下来，我们为我们的二元关系提供必要且充分的条件，并提出一个更简单且易于验证的充分条件。我们进一步探讨了信息结构在长期收益、极限福利和典型二元环境中的比较。

records.title_en: Intergenerational cultural transmission with social interactions as an evolutionary game
records.title_cn: 代际文化传递与社会互动的演化博弈
records.abstract_en: This paper studies a multi-trait cultural transmission model with social interactions. The resulting cultural dynamic is equivalent to an evolutionary dynamic on a population game that combines social payoffs and cultural biases. This transformation allows us to apply tools from evolutionary game theory to examine cultural homogeneity and heterogeneity. We show that when social interactions have a coordination nature, cultural biases can push the cultural dynamic toward selecting a culturally homogeneous equilibrium that is efficient for those interactions. In contrast, when interactions have an anti-coordination nature, cultural biases usually drive the dynamic toward a culturally heterogeneous state that differs from the efficient equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个具有社会互动的多特征文化传递模型。由此产生的文化动态等价于一个结合了社会收益和文化偏好的种群博弈上的演化动态。这一转换使我们能够运用演化博弈论的工具来考察文化的同质性与异质性。我们表明，当社会互动具有协调性质时，文化偏好可以推动文化动态趋向于选择一个对这些互动而言高效的文化同质均衡。相反，当互动具有反协调性质时，文化偏好通常会使动态趋向于一个不同于高效均衡的文化异质状态。

records.title_en: The comparative statics of dominance
records.title_cn: 优势的比较静态分析
records.abstract_en: In finite problems comprising objects, cases, and an object- and case-contingent payoff function, we study the comparative statics of the set of undominated objects, meaning those for which there exists no mixture over objects that is superior in every case. We consider both weak and strict dominance (corresponding to different degrees of ‘strictness’ in the definition of superiority). Our main theorem characterises those payoff transformations which robustly expand the not-weakly-dominated and not-strictly-dominated sets: the necessary and sufficient condition is that payoffs be transformed separately across cases, in either a monotone–concave or a constant manner. We apply our results to Pareto frontiers and games.
records.abstract_cn: 在由对象、情形以及依赖于对象和情形的收益函数构成的有限问题中，我们研究了无优势对象集合的比较静态性质，其中无优势对象是指不存在任何在每种情形下都更优的对象混合。我们同时考虑弱优势和严格优势（对应于优势定义中‘严格性’的不同程度）。我们的主要定理刻画了那些能够稳健地扩大非弱优势和非严格优势集合的收益变换：必要且充分条件是收益在每种情形下分别进行变换，且变换方式要么是单调凹的，要么是常数形式的。我们将结果应用于帕累托前沿和博弈。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: The systemic impact of edges in financial networks
records.title_cn: 金融网络中边的系统性影响
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we assess how the stability of financial networks is affected by interconnectedness considering its tiniest variation: the edge. We compute the impact of edges as the percentage difference in the systemic risk (SR) of the whole network caused by the inclusion of that edge. We apply this framework to a thorough Brazilian dataset to compute the impact of bank-firm edges. After observing that (i) edges are heterogeneous regarding their impact on the SR, and (ii) the fraction of edges whose impact on the SR is non-positive increases with the level of the initial shock, we use machine learning techniques to try to predict two variables: the criticality of the edges (defining as critical an edge whose impact on SR is significantly greater than that of the others) and the sign of the edge impact. The level of accuracy obtained in these prediction exercises was very high. Our study has important implications for the development of macroprudential policies aimed at financial stability in at least two ways. First, it proposes a framework for the identification of systemically relevant edges. Second, by identifying which features of the origin and destination nodes of the edge (i.e., the lending bank and the borrowing firm) are more related to its systemic relevance, our framework suggests additional criteria for the identification of systemically important banks and firms.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们评估金融网络的稳定性如何受到互联性的影响，考虑其最微小的变化：边。我们计算边的影响为整个网络系统性风险（SR）因包含该边而产生的百分比差异。我们将此框架应用于一个全面的巴西数据集，以计算银行-企业边的影响。在观察到（i）边对其对SR的影响具有异质性，以及（ii）对SR影响非正的边的比例随初始冲击水平增加而增加之后，我们使用机器学习技术尝试预测两个变量：边的关键性（将关键边定义为对SR影响显著大于其他边的边）和边影响的符号。这些预测练习获得的准确度非常高。我们的研究对制定旨在金融稳定的宏观审慎政策具有至少两个重要启示。首先，它提出了一个识别系统性相关边的框架。其次，通过识别边的起点和终点节点（即贷款银行和借款企业）的哪些特征与其系统性相关性更相关，我们的框架为识别系统重要性银行和企业提出了额外标准。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: A quantitative analysis of multidimensional changes in unemployment insurance policies
records.title_cn: 失业保险政策多维变化的定量分析
records.abstract_en: The US government has historically expanded unemployment insurance (UI) during economic downturns along three policy dimensions: benefit amount, duration, and eligibility. We study how these elements affect the labor market, focusing in particular on the interaction among them. Specifically, we quantify the impact of the Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security (CARES) Act UI package, which combined all three during the COVID-19 pandemic. The package raised average unemployment rate by 1.05 percentage points during April–December 2020. Two-thirds of this effect resulted from amplification by economic shutdown policies and COVID-19 infection risk. Decomposing the CARES Act UI package reveals that interactions between the three policy dimensions accounted for one-fourth of the total effect, highlighting that policy components do not operate in isolation.
records.abstract_cn: 美国政府历来在经济衰退期间沿三个政策维度扩大失业保险（UI）：福利金额、期限和资格。我们研究这些要素如何影响劳动力市场，特别关注它们之间的相互作用。具体而言，我们量化了《冠状病毒援助、救济和经济安全（CARES）法案》UI方案的影响，该方案在COVID-19大流行期间结合了所有三个维度。该方案在2020年四月至十二月期间将平均失业率提高了1.05个百分点。这一影响的三分之二来自经济封锁政策和COVID-19感染风险的放大效应。对CARES法案UI方案的分解显示，三个政策维度之间的相互作用占总影响的四分之一，突显出政策组成部分并非孤立运作。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: An analytical heterogeneous agent macro model of concentration, markups, and falling labour shares
records.title_cn: 一个关于集中度、加成率和劳动份额下降的分析性异质主体宏观模型
records.abstract_en: This paper presents an analytical heterogeneous agent model (HAM) to explore micro-level concentration dynamics and their effects on macro-level distribution and growth. It contributes to recent work on macroeconomic agent-based models (ABMs) by comparing a small-scale ABM with bilateral firm-customer matching to a simplified HAM without direct agent interactions. The HAM replicates key ABM results while allowing for analytical solutions. In the model, larger firms benefit from lower unit costs due to economies of scale, gain larger market shares, and set higher markups. More profitable firms temporarily grow faster, leading to endogenous changes in the firm size distribution. The resulting right-skewed distributions create a divergence between the average profit share across firms and the aggregate profit share, which is driven by the largest firms. The decline in the labour share reduces aggregate consumption and slows growth. Despite its simplicity, the model captures key empirical patterns related to superstar firms and declining labour shares.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个分析性异质主体模型（HAM），以探讨微观层面的集中度动态及其对宏观层面分配和增长的影响。它通过将一个小规模的双边企业-客户匹配的基于主体的模型（ABM）与一个没有直接主体互动的简化HAM进行比较，为近期宏观经济基于主体的模型（ABMs）的研究做出了贡献。HAM在允许解析解的同时，复现了ABM的关键结果。在模型中，规模较大的企业由于规模经济而享有较低的单位成本，获得更大的市场份额，并设定更高的加成率。利润更高的企业暂时增长更快，导致企业规模分布的内生变化。由此产生的右偏分布造成了企业间平均利润份额与总体利润份额之间的差异，后者由最大的企业驱动。劳动份额的下降减少了总消费并减缓了增长。尽管模型简单，但它捕捉了与超级明星企业和劳动份额下降相关的关键经验模式。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Nominal GDP targeting and the tax burden
records.title_cn: 名义GDP目标与税收负担
records.abstract_en: Recent work suggests that nominal GDP targeting may raise social welfare, but fiscal considerations have largely been ignored. We study an overlapping generations model with government debt and distortionary taxes. Nominal GDP targeting has two opposing effects on the tax burden: mean taxes increase, but tax volatility is reduced. Differently to previous works, we find that nominal GDP targeting lowers social welfare relative to inflation targeting. A key mechanism is that nominal GDP targeting makes inflation countercyclical, thereby raising long run inflation risk and consumption risk of retirees while increasing the inflation risk premium paid on government debt.
records.abstract_cn: 近期研究表明，名义GDP目标可能提高社会福利，但财政因素在很大程度上被忽视了。我们研究了一个包含政府债务和扭曲性税收的代际交叠模型。名义GDP目标对税收负担有两种相反的影响：平均税收增加，但税收波动性降低。与以往研究不同，我们发现相对于通胀目标，名义GDP目标降低了社会福利。一个关键机制是，名义GDP目标使通胀呈逆周期性，从而提高了长期通胀风险和退休人员的消费风险，同时增加了政府债务支付的通胀风险溢价。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Worker skills, firm dynamics, and productivity
records.title_cn: 工人技能、企业动态与生产率
records.abstract_en: We develop a general equilibrium model of firm dynamics with multiple labour skills to analyse the productivity implications of skill shortages. Firms employ cognitive, interpersonal, and manual skills in both operational and overhead tasks, with sectoral variation in skill intensities, and within sector firm size heterogeneity due to idiosyncratic technology draws. Calibrated to UK data, the model reveals that cognitive skills are a binding constraint on productivity. A reduction in the supply of cognitive skills lowers labour productivity at all levels – firms, sectors, and in the aggregate. About half of the sectoral effects are due to changes in the within-sector distribution, whereby larger firms grow in relative size but become less productive. Sectoral heterogeneity in skill intensities amplifies these effects.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含多种劳动技能的企业动态一般均衡模型，以分析技能短缺对生产率的影响。企业在运营和行政任务中雇佣认知、人际和手工技能，各行业的技能密集度存在差异，且行业内企业规模因特殊技术冲击而具有异质性。以英国数据校准后，模型揭示认知技能是生产率的约束性瓶颈。认知技能供给的减少会降低所有层面——企业、行业以及总体——的劳动生产率。约一半的行业效应源于行业内分布的变化，即规模较大的企业相对规模扩大但生产率下降。行业间技能密集度的异质性放大了这些效应。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Uncertain climate policy and activist investing
records.title_cn: 不确定的气候政策与积极投资
records.abstract_en: We develop a dynamic theory of sustainable investment in which emission-based government regulation simultaneously stimulates green investment and creates policy-induced transition risk. A novel market failure emerges: policy uncertainty generates both financial value and pro-social values for emission mitigation, but firms internalize only the financial benefits and therefore underinvest in mitigation, triggering the emission rebound effect. Investor activism can alleviate this distortion and incentivize green investment. Finally, we show that activism reduces the need for aggressive policy intervention. This substitution effect is weakened by advisory costs of activism but strengthened by green innovation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个可持续投资的动态理论，其中基于排放的政府监管同时刺激绿色投资并产生政策引发的转型风险。一种新颖的市场失灵出现了：政策不确定性既为减排创造财务价值，也创造亲社会价值，但企业仅内化财务收益，因此在减排方面投资不足，引发排放反弹效应。投资者积极主义可以缓解这种扭曲并激励绿色投资。最后，我们表明积极主义减少了对激进政策干预的需求。这种替代效应因积极主义的咨询成本而减弱，但因绿色创新而增强。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Centralized and competitive extraction of distributed renewable resources on networks with nonlinear aggregate growth
records.title_cn: 网络上分布式可再生资源的集中与竞争性开采：具有非线性总量增长
records.abstract_en: We study the optimal and strategic extraction of a renewable resource that is spatially distributed over a network, migrates across nodes (with no loss of biomass during transit), and evolves according to a nonlinear (concave) aggregate growth function. A subset of nodes hosts extractors, while the remaining ones serve as reserves. We analyze a centralized planner’s problem and a non-cooperative game with stationary Markov strategies. For three canonical growth families (logistic, power, and log-type saturating laws) paired with corresponding utilities, we derive closed-form value functions and feedback rules for the planner, and we construct a symmetric Markov equilibrium for the game on strongly connected networks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在网络上空间分布、跨节点迁移（迁移过程中生物量无损失）并根据非线性（凹）总量增长函数演化的可再生资源的最优和策略性开采。一部分节点设有开采者，其余节点作为保护区。我们分析了集中规划者的问题以及具有平稳马尔可夫策略的非合作博弈。对于三个典型增长族（逻辑斯蒂、幂函数和对数型饱和定律）与相应效用函数配对，我们推导了规划者的闭式价值函数和反馈规则，并在强连通网络上构建了博弈的对称马尔可夫均衡。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Macroeconomic effects of carbon pricing: The role of bank credit
records.title_cn: 碳定价的宏观经济效应：银行信贷的作用
records.abstract_en: This paper quantifies the role of bank lending in shaping the short-run effects of climate policy on the economy. Using carbon price surprises from the EU Emissions Trading System we document that higher carbon prices, while successfully reducing emissions, lead to lower economic activity, lower bank capital and higher credit spreads. We further show that banks with greater exposure to emission-intensive industries reduce credit supply more strongly in response to an increase in carbon price. We interpret these empirical facts through the lens of a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model with polluting and non-polluting sectors, nominal price rigidities, and a bank credit channel. The model matches well the empirical impulse responses of key aggregates to a carbon policy shock. Counterfactual simulations suggest that the bank credit channel plays a quantitatively meaningful role in the transmission of carbon policy shocks. Finally, implications for the design of macroprudential and monetary policies are explored.
records.abstract_cn: 本文量化了银行信贷在塑造气候政策对经济短期影响中的作用。利用欧盟排放交易体系的碳价格意外，我们记录了更高的碳价格虽然成功减少了排放，但导致经济活动下降、银行资本减少和信用利差扩大。我们进一步表明，对排放密集型行业敞口较大的银行，在碳价格上升时信贷供给减少得更强烈。我们通过一个包含污染和非污染部门、名义价格刚性以及银行信贷渠道的动态随机一般均衡模型来解释这些实证事实。该模型很好地匹配了碳政策冲击对关键总量的实证脉冲响应。反事实模拟表明，银行信贷渠道在碳政策冲击的传导中发挥了数量上显著的作用。最后，探讨了对宏观审慎和货币政策设计的启示。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Opportunistic sovereign default under a credible peg
records.title_cn: 可信钉住汇率下的机会主义主权违约
records.abstract_en: In the African Financial Community (CFA) franc zones, a credible euro peg coexists with external debt denominated largely in U.S. dollars: euro–dollar fluctuations, exogenous to these small economies, directly raise the domestic-currency burden of debt. Panel regressions show that such depreciations raise sovereign default intensity by roughly 9%. In these same high-default years, consumption does not fall—evidence against the insurance motive of standard default models. I explain both facts by extending the partial default framework of Arellano et al. (2023) with foreign-currency debt, exogenous exchange rate shocks, and government heterogeneity. Exogeneity changes the nature of default: governments default not for insurance but opportunistically, exploiting the valuation gap between the higher debt burden and the higher revenue from new borrowing, generating a short-run rise in consumption. A policy counterfactual finds leaving for a self-managed dollar peg welfare-neutral on the financial side: opportunistic default insures the mismatch so effectively that a country profits from devaluations whatever their source, so the arrangement’s value lies not in shielding the debt but in the exogenous-devaluation environment that makes default opportunistic.
records.abstract_cn: 在非洲金融共同体（CFA）法郎区，可信的欧元钉住与主要以美元计价的外部债务并存：欧元兑美元汇率的波动，对这些小经济体而言是外生的，直接提高了债务的本币负担。面板回归显示，此类贬值会使主权违约强度提高约9%。在这些高违约年份中，消费并未下降——这与标准违约模型的保险动机相悖。我通过将Arellano等人（2023）的部分违约框架扩展至外币债务、外生汇率冲击和政府异质性来解释这两个事实。外生性改变了违约的性质：政府违约并非出于保险目的，而是机会主义地利用更高债务负担与新增借款更高收入之间的估值缺口，从而在短期内推高消费。一项政策反事实分析发现，转向自我管理的美元钉住在金融方面是福利中性的：机会主义违约如此有效地对冲了错配，以至于无论贬值来源如何，国家都能从中获利，因此该安排的价值不在于保护债务，而在于使违约具有机会主义性质的外生贬值环境。

records.title_en: Annual overseas migration and housing markets: Evidence from Australian neighborhoods
records.title_cn: 年度海外移民与住房市场：来自澳大利亚街区的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of net overseas migration (NOM) on residential property markets using annual, neighborhood-level data for Australia. We apply an instrumental variable strategy based on historical immigrant settlement patterns to isolate exogenous variation in migration flows. A one percentage point increase in NOM as a share of the local population raises house rents by 2.8% and unit rents by 4.3%, and increases unit prices by 3.2%. The baseline effect on house prices is not statistically significant, though cumulative estimates over one- and two-year horizons become negative and significant. The effects of immigration on prices and rents are lower in older neighborhoods, consistent with an amenity interpretation where attitudes toward immigrants are less favorable among older residents, counteracting positive demand pressures. Finally, our estimated impacts on the out-migration of incumbent residents are limited and, if anything, smaller than those reported in the previous literature.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用澳大利亚年度街区层面数据，研究净海外移民（NOM）对住宅房地产市场的影响。我们采用基于历史移民定居模式的工具变量策略，以隔离移民流动中的外生变化。NOM占当地人口比例每增加一个百分点，房屋租金提高2.8%，单元房租金提高4.3%，单元房价格提高3.2%。对房价的基线效应在统计上不显著，但一年和两年期的累积估计变为负值且显著。移民对价格和租金的影响在老年社区较低，这与便利设施解释一致，即老年居民对移民的态度不太友好，抵消了正向的需求压力。最后，我们估计的对现有居民向外迁移的影响有限，且如果有什么不同的话，比先前文献报告的要小。

records.title_en: Organizational culture and habit formation in public procurement
records.title_cn: 公共采购中的组织文化与习惯形成
records.abstract_en: We study the extent of a one-size-fits-all approach in the design of public procurement (PP) tenders using comprehensive data from Finland. We show that crucial PP design features related to auction and contract rules tend to have significant lack of variation across different tenders for different industries within a contracting authority. We show that this organizational rigidness is due to both organizational level culture and individual employee level work habit formation with the latter being more important. We find that both greater organizational rigidity and deviating from the national industry norms are associated with lower number of bids and higher probability of zero-bid tenders, pointing to a potential efficiency loss from organizational rigidness in PP, and offering a solution that buyers could mimic how other organizations typically buy similar products rather than how they themselves buy very different products.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用芬兰的综合数据，研究了公共采购（PP）招标设计中“一刀切”方法的程度。我们表明，与拍卖和合同规则相关的关键PP设计特征，在同一个采购机构的不同行业的不同招标中，往往缺乏显著的变化。我们表明，这种组织刚性既源于组织层面的文化，也源于员工个人层面的工作习惯形成，其中后者更为重要。我们发现，更大的组织刚性和偏离国家行业规范都与更低的投标数量和更高的零投标招标概率相关，这表明PP中的组织刚性可能导致效率损失，并提供一个解决方案，即买方可以模仿其他组织通常如何购买类似产品，而不是模仿他们自己如何购买非常不同的产品。

records.title_en: Diversity in teams: Collaboration and performance in experiments with different tasks
records.title_cn: 团队多样性：不同任务实验中的协作与绩效
records.abstract_en: The effect of demographic diversity on teamwork remains theoretically ambiguous. More diverse teams may benefit from more creativity and knowledge sharing, but they also face higher communication and coordination costs. This paper tests these competing mechanisms in the context of higher education. We exploit an experimental setting in a large undergraduate class, where students are randomly assigned to small homework groups, with varying levels of diversity in terms of race, gender, and place of birth. We find that the relationship between diversity and performance depends systematically on the task environment: more diverse groups outperform less diverse groups in open-ended, generative tasks, but underperform in more structured analytical tasks. We then address the effect of team diversity on coordination and communication, building an index of teamwork quality based on collaboration between members, the balance of member contributions, and the absence of conflicts. We find that diversity has a U-shaped effect on teamwork quality, regardless of the type of task performed. This result suggests that faultlines – dividing lines that split a group into subgroups based on demographic characteristics – can cause inter-subgroup cohesion to break down, while very homogeneous or very heterogeneous groups collaborate better. The results help provide a framework to understand optimal team composition for institutions and organizations.
records.abstract_cn: 人口统计学多样性对团队合作的影响在理论上仍不明确。更多样化的团队可能受益于更多的创造力和知识共享，但也面临更高的沟通和协调成本。本文在高等教育背景下检验了这些相互竞争的机制。我们利用了一个大型本科班级的实验设置，学生被随机分配到小型作业小组，这些小组在种族、性别和出生地方面的多样性程度各不相同。我们发现，多样性与绩效之间的关系系统地取决于任务环境：更多样化的群体在开放式、生成性任务中表现优于较少多样化的群体，但在更结构化的分析性任务中表现不佳。随后，我们探讨了团队多样性对协调和沟通的影响，基于成员之间的协作、成员贡献的平衡以及冲突的缺失构建了一个团队合作质量指数。我们发现，无论执行何种类型的任务，多样性对团队合作质量都有U型影响。这一结果表明，断层线——根据人口统计学特征将群体划分为子群体的分界线——可能导致子群体间的凝聚力瓦解，而非常同质或非常异质的群体合作得更好。这些结果有助于为机构和组织理解最优团队构成提供一个框架。

records.title_en: Does happiness spread within organizations? Evidence from a field experiment in Norway
records.title_cn: 幸福感会在组织内传播吗？来自挪威的一项实地实验的证据
records.abstract_en: We report the results from a large field experiment that tests if happiness spreads within an organizational setting, as predicted by the emotional contagion hypothesis. Although some studies have supported this hypothesis, no well-powered randomized controlled trial has ever tested it in the field. In collaboration with the Norwegian Armed Forces, we randomly assign over 1500 recruits to rooms during eight-week boot camps. Some recruits live with relatively happier peers while others live with relatively unhappier ones. We find no evidence of happiness convergence at the room level and reject even small contagion effects. We show that the null result is not explained by excessive stability in happiness, and prior studies in the same setting show that peer effects emerge for some non-emotional attitudes. These results call for a reconsideration of the presumed ubiquity of happiness spillovers, with subsequent implications for well-being models and policies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们报告了一项大型实地实验的结果，该实验检验了幸福感是否会在组织环境中传播，正如情绪传染假说所预测的那样。尽管一些研究支持了这一假说，但尚无一项具有充分效力的随机对照试验在实地对其进行过检验。我们与挪威武装部队合作，在为期八周的新兵训练营期间，将超过1500名新兵随机分配到不同房间。一些新兵与相对更快乐的同伴同住，而另一些则与相对不那么快乐的同伴同住。我们没有发现房间层面幸福感趋同的证据，并且拒绝了即使是微小的传染效应。我们表明，这一零结果并非由幸福感的过度稳定性所解释，而在相同环境下的先前研究表明，某些非情绪态度会出现同伴效应。这些结果呼吁重新审视幸福感溢出效应的普遍性假设，并对幸福感模型和政策产生后续影响。

records.title_en: Does slow strategizing indicate optimal behavior or uncertainty?
records.title_cn: 缓慢的策略制定是表明最优行为还是不确定性？
records.abstract_en: In simple choice, slower decisions tend to indicate proximity to indifference and thus less predictable choice. In complex situations, some studies have argued that slower decisions indicate more reasoning and thus more optimal decisions. However, those studies rely on games where the optimal responses are debatable – they depend on agents’ beliefs or social preferences. Thus, it is unclear whether being slow is a good or bad sign. Here, we examine whether fast decisions are more or less optimal in high and low complexity, zero-sum games with dominant strategies and limited social-preference concerns. We study repeated 2-person p-beauty contests, where halfway through the experiment we switch the multiplier, changing the dominant strategy. Only 33% of subjects correctly adjusted after the switch, an indication of understanding the dominant strategy. Those who continued to play the dominant strategy showed a decrease in response time (RT) upon playing the dominant strategy, while those who later switched away from the dominant strategy did not. Contrary to the predictions for complex games, subjects exhibited negative correlations between RT and optimal choice, both in the early rounds and after the switch. Thus, we find no support for the notion that slower decisions result in better choices.
records.abstract_cn: 在简单选择中，较慢的决策往往表明接近无差异，因此选择的可预测性较低。在复杂情境中，一些研究认为较慢的决策表明更多的推理，从而更优的决策。然而，这些研究依赖于最优反应存在争议的博弈——它们取决于参与者的信念或社会偏好。因此，尚不清楚缓慢是好的还是坏的迹象。在此，我们考察在具有主导策略和有限社会偏好关注的高复杂度和低复杂度的零和博弈中，快速决策是否更优或更差。我们研究了重复的2人p-美容竞赛，在实验中途我们切换乘数，改变主导策略。只有33%的受试者在切换后正确调整，这表明他们理解了主导策略。那些继续玩主导策略的人在玩主导策略时反应时间（RT）下降，而那些后来偏离主导策略的人则没有。与复杂博弈的预测相反，受试者在早期轮次和切换后都表现出RT与最优选择之间的负相关。因此，我们没有发现支持较慢决策导致更好选择的观点的证据。

records.title_en: Market versus state in driving growth: An institutional interpretation of TFP changes in China
records.title_cn: 市场与政府在驱动增长中的作用：中国全要素生产率变化的制度解读
records.abstract_en: By institutionally rethinking the Solow residual in light of how the interplay of policy interventions and market forces affects factor income shares, we attempt to interpret China’s TFP performance from an institutional perspective. To explore the growth–efficiency paradox inherent in the China model of growth, we apply the Jorgensonian APPF–Domar growth accounting framework to the revised and updated CIP/China KLEMS dataset. The framework coherently integrates industry productivity accounts with national accounts to distinguish TFP growth caused by changes in factor utilization within industries from TFP growth caused by changes in factor reallocation between industries. By regrouping 37 Chinese industries according to their distance from state controls (or, conversely, their proximity to final demand) and dividing the entire 1978–2023 period into subperiods to reflect major policy and institutional changes and external shocks, we show that capital reallocation brought about strong TFP gains when both the government and the market happened to address similar structural problems, but policy efforts toward growth inevitably led to efficiency losses and ultimately hindered China’s growth.
records.abstract_cn: 通过从制度角度重新思考索洛残差，并考虑政策干预与市场力量相互作用如何影响要素收入份额，我们试图从制度视角解读中国的全要素生产率表现。为了探究中国增长模式中固有的增长-效率悖论，我们将乔根森式APPF-多马增长核算框架应用于修订和更新的CIP/中国KLEMS数据集。该框架将行业生产率账户与国民账户连贯地整合在一起，以区分由行业内要素利用率变化引起的全要素生产率增长与由行业间要素重新配置变化引起的全要素生产率增长。通过根据行业与国家控制的距离（或相反，与最终需求的接近程度）对37个中国行业进行重新分组，并将整个1978-2023时期划分为子时期以反映重大政策、制度变化和外部冲击，我们表明，当政府和市场恰好解决类似的结构性问题时，资本重新配置带来了强劲的全要素生产率收益，但促进增长的政策努力不可避免地导致效率损失，并最终阻碍了中国增长。

records.title_en: Do you remember? Prosocial behavior declines in memory-based decisions
records.title_cn: 你还记得吗？基于记忆的决策中亲社会行为下降
records.abstract_en: Many economic decisions affect other stakeholders, yet information about these consequences is often not directly available at the moment of choice and must instead be recalled from memory. Here, three studies examine how memory processes shape social behavior and whether their behavioral effects are better explained by motivated memory or rational accounts of memory allocation. In Study 1, participants made binary dictator-game decisions in which the consequences for themselves and another player were represented by pictures whose monetary outcomes had to be learned and later recalled from memory. Compared with the control condition in which all outcome information was available on the decision screen, participants chose less prosocially when decisions relied on memory. Studies 2 and 3 showed that prosocial choice in memory-based dictator games did not reliably increase either when strategic encoding of outcomes was made impossible or when accurate recall was monetarily incentivized. A structural model with a social utility function indicates that memory-based decisions reduce the weight placed on the other player’s outcome in unequal allocations that are advantageous to the dictator. Across choices, recall patterns, structural modeling, and individual differences, the results are most consistent with motivated forgetting during decision making: participants appear to selectively fail to retrieve information about social consequences when this information would make selfish choices harder to justify. These findings suggest that making consequences for other stakeholders salient at the moment of choice can promote socially beneficial behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 许多经济决策会影响其他利益相关者，然而关于这些后果的信息在选择时往往无法直接获得，而必须从记忆中回忆。本文通过三项研究考察记忆过程如何塑造社会行为，以及其行为效应是否能更好地由动机性记忆或理性记忆分配解释。在研究1中，参与者进行二元独裁者博弈决策，其中自己和另一玩家的结果由图片表示，图片的货币结果需要学习并在之后从记忆中回忆。与所有结果信息在决策屏幕上可用的控制条件相比，当决策依赖记忆时，参与者选择亲社会的程度较低。研究2和3表明，在基于记忆的独裁者博弈中，无论是使结果的策略性编码不可能，还是对准确回忆给予货币激励，亲社会选择都没有可靠增加。一个带有社会效用函数的结构模型表明，基于记忆的决策降低了对独裁者有利的不平等分配中另一玩家结果的权重。在跨选择、回忆模式、结构建模和个体差异方面，结果与决策过程中的动机性遗忘最为一致：参与者似乎选择性地未能检索关于社会后果的信息，当这些信息会使自私选择更难合理化时。这些发现表明，在选择时使其他利益相关者的后果变得突出可以促进对社会有益的行为。

records.title_en: Emergency department visits and temperature: Evidence from Mexico
records.title_cn: 急诊就诊与温度：来自墨西哥的证据
